title: Charge-transfer-activated SERS detection of methylene blue using an ultrastable, reliable, and highly sensitive semiconductor Fe3O4@C@TiO2 nano-platform
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,21152-21167
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00307A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Quan-Doan Mai, Dang Thi Hang Trang, Ngo Thi Loan, Ong Van Hoang, Ta Ngoc Bach, Nguyen Quang Hoa, Nhu Hoa Thi Tran, Anh-Tuan Pham, Anh-Tuan Le
We report a metal-free Fe3O4@C@TiO2 heterostructure SERS platform enabling efficient semiconductor-molecule charge transfer via interfacial states, achieving sensitivity approaching noble-metal systems with ultrastable and reliable performance.
